facts.value: Josef Stammel carved the lime-wood sculptures of the hall. The best known group is The Four Last Things: Death, Judgement, Heaven and Hell.
facts.quote: Unique sculptures made from lime wood Josef Stammel, the sculptor of Admont Abbey, created the imposing sculptures in the Ceremonial Hall.
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://stiftadmont.at/en/about-the-abbey-library/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'sculptures made from lime wood Josef Stammel'

facts.value: The hall was designed for the Enlightenment, with the stated aim of filling the room with light as well as the mind.
facts.quote: the hall reflects the spirit of the Enlightenment - a room that was deliberately designed with light and space
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://stiftadmont.at/en/about-the-abbey-library/' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'deliberately designed with light and space'

events.label: A fire destroys large parts of the abbey but spares the library.
events.quote: In 1865, a major fire destroyed large parts of the monastery, with the exception of the library.

events.quote: The Nazi regime confiscates all the assets of Admont Abbey; the monks are forced to leave the monastery.
